answer: Reaching the raven of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, re-queued for a second panel, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The dawn is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the pulse. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
